descriptions.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Lileeane's Jewel' Rare Red Variegated Japanese Maple Zones 5-9 Acer palmatum 'Lileeane's Jewel' is a brand new introduction with a rare variegation of pink and white on a bright cherry red and heavily divided leaf. Mid-summer colors are a green-red with pink and white variegation. It is estimated to get about 10-12 ft in 15 years. Fall colors are crimson reds infused with hot pink variegation. This selection is fairly heat tolerant as it has handled the sun of Simpsonville, SC, without burn to the variegation. The variegation appears fairly stable. However, since this is a new cultivar, we suggest avoiding heavy fertilizers. Any branches not showing variegation should be trimmed out. This rare Japanese maple was found as a chance seedling by our friend, Johnathon Savelich, and named after his daughter, Lileeane.

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer palmatum 'Lileeane's Jewel' 稀有红叶斑锦日本枫，适生分区 5-9。 Acer palmatum 'Lileeane's Jewel' 是一个全新引入品种，在鲜樱桃红色且深裂的叶片上，具有少见的粉色和白色斑锦。 仲夏时叶色转为带粉白斑锦的绿红色。 预计 15 年可长至约 10-12 英尺。 秋色为深红色，并带有亮粉色斑锦。 该品种较耐热，在南卡罗来纳州 Simpsonville 的日照条件下，其斑锦未出现灼伤。 其斑锦表现看起来较为稳定。 不过由于这是新品种，我们建议避免施用重肥。 凡是不显斑的枝条应及时修剪掉。 这株稀有日本枫由我们的朋友 Johnathon Savelich 作为偶发实生苗发现，并以其女儿 Lileeane 的名字命名。
